scope: FastAPI assessment only; no production code, assessment test, processor or mock changes during this review

test_run.environment: fresh virtual environment in an artifact-free source snapshot; no existing venv, caches or editable-install metadata copied

git_metadata_note: No .git history or remote was supplied. Git ignore rules were checked using temporary Git metadata; installation and the complete suite were verified from a clean source snapshot rather than an actual remote clone.
remaining_limitations: Exactly-once remote effects after response loss, expired ownership or a crash require receiver deduplication/reconciliation; the mock provides neither.
Observed ambiguous delivery outcomes are failed for reconciliation, not automatically retried.
SQLite has one writer; four-ASGI-process performance is not benchmarked and per-process CPU budgets need tuning.
SIGKILL bypasses cleanup and running child CPU work may outlive the graceful drain interval; active-claim recovery can wait up to the default 15-second lease.
Raw input is stored until preprocessing completes; setting it to NULL does not securely erase WAL history or backups.
Tests require the documented local ports to be free; performance measurements are local hardware observations.
